clinical_intent: A treatment plan uses a ring applicator with an inner diameter of 2.6 cm. The prescribed dose is delivered at the isodose surface that encompasses 100% of the applicator surface. If the dose at the applicator surface is 150% of the prescription dose, calculate the dose at 5 mm and 10 mm from the applicator surface using the point source approximation. Discuss the accuracy limitations of this approximation.
